fieldValues.title: Drafts
fieldValues.summary: Blocks set aside from the page. Drag a block here to set it aside, and back onto the page to place it; Put back adds it at the end.
fieldValues.explanation: Nothing is deleted by taking it off the page: a block in Drafts keeps its words. A draft derived from a block on the page is that block's alternative, offered in the inspector.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: Agents may draft alternatives here, but the writer decides what reaches the page.
